reasons: The cited Section 22 matches the preferred position on every material term: once per twelve months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; the deterministic frequency check passes.
Rationale is accurate and additionally notes pro-Customer protections in 22.3 (findings as Customer Confidential Information, delivery of final report), so no negotiation issue should be raised.
